name: skerry
author: grids-agent
description: EASY. Grid of '#' and '.'; the answer is the number of 4-connected components of '#' cells ('count the islands'), written in decimal. The generator only ever places a '#' on a cell with 0 or 1 existing '#' neighbours, so the rock set is always a forest in the grid graph; therefore components == V - E, and the 256-char scorer can recompute the answer with two sum() comprehensions instead of a flood fill. Players do not need to know that: an ordinary flood fill gives the same number. Discovery path: clue is an obvious blobby grid, answer is a small number (typically 4-18). Hypotheses to eliminate: count of '#' cells, count of '.' cells, rows, components. One demo (grid + number) plus one or two rounds of feedback settles it, and 'number of blobs' is the natural human read of the picture.
